summary: TikTok's main friction themes revolve around content moderation, gender sensitivity, and user experience issues.

themes.name: Platform Perception & Brand Image
themes.description: TikTok is perceived as a platform that promotes simplistic, shallow, or politically charged content, which some users find concerning and potentially harmful to younger audiences.
themes.recommendation: Enhance content quality and moderation to reinforce a positive brand image and user trust.

themes.name: Content Moderation & Censorship
themes.description: Users report that TikTok is censoring terms related to women and gender, such as 'woman', 'mujer', and other feminine identifiers, leading to frustration and accusations of sexism and misogyny.
themes.recommendation: Review and clarify content moderation policies to address user concerns about gender-related censorship.

themes.name: Search & Discovery Experience
themes.description: Users are frustrated with the search bar's inability to correctly recognize and display terms related to women and gender, leading to confusion and a sense of being excluded.
themes.recommendation: Improve search algorithms to better handle gender-related terms and reduce user confusion.
